ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 9:1 ratio of low-intensity black pixels to high-intensity white and light-gray pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black field covering the majority of the surface; high-intensity white/brown pixel cluster at the distal tip of the left lobe; multiple thin, white linear streaks distributed across the central and left-central areas; sparse white circular spots on the right lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped depression; right-side boundary partially obscured by water surface and entanglement gear.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, low-frequency serrations visible along the left trailing edge; right trailing edge is null due to water occlusion.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve visible on the left lobe lobe ending in a jagged distal tip; right lobe trajectory is null due to water occlusion.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated high-contrast white and brown cluster at the left distal tip; multiple isolated white circular pixel clusters (approx. 10-15) scattered on the right side of the fluke.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous distinct, parallel white linear markings (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the central-left ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the left distal tip; widespread linear rake mark scarring; entanglement with a buoy and line at the peduncle junction.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of an orange and white cylindrical buoy with numeric marking '31' and a green/teal frayed rope attached near the fluke base.
